sentences.text:
The Court made the following Order:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for the respondents and learned Government Pleader for land acquisition appearing for respondent No.4.
2.

The petitioner herein is a Secretary of the Petitioner Society i.e., Sree Savara Polamma Off-Shore Rythu Samkshma Sangham which was registered under the provisions of the Societies Registration Act, 1860 on 20.01.2021.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: After formation of Society, the members of the Society submitted a representation dated 03.12.2020 requesting respondent Nos.7 and 8 herein for change of alignment of laying Off-Shore Reservoir left channel.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the said representation of the Society was considered by respondent Nos.7 and 8 and rejected the claim of petitioner vide proceedings dated Sree Savara Polamma Off Shore Rythu ... vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176734474/
1 05.01.2021 by observing as under:
"5.Technicalities and equality:

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The alignment is proposed to give water to all the farmers who are in tail end to do equal justice.

The Superintendent Engineer, BRR Vamsadhara Project Circle, Srikakulam dated 05.10.2020 and the Executive Engineer (FAC), BRR Vamsadhara Project main canal division, Tekkali dated 31.10.2020 and present Executive Engineer (FAC), BRR Vamsadhara Project main canal division, Tekkali dated 24.11.2020 thoroughly verified and expressed that it is very difficult to construct the canal and the expenditure is very high.

entities.text: BRR Vamsadhara Project main canal division
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The Chief Engineer, North Coast, Visakhapatnam is accepted after the thorough verification of the officers of off shore reservoir left main canal alignment from Regulapadu to the tail end to Guddibadra Village.
The construction and acquisition of the land is very difficult if the request which is made by the Savarapolamma society and the cost of the construction of the canal financial is more high.

There is no response from the higher officials to change the alignment so that the land acquisition is taking as it is."
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the said endorsement without considering the objections and difficulties of the petitioner society is arbitrary and liable to be rejected.

5. On the other hand, learned Government Pleader furnished written instructions issued by respondent Nos.6 and 7, dated 06.03.2024 wherein it is stated as under:
" The alignment of Left Main Canal of Off Shore Reservoir which is technically feasible was approved by the Chief Engineer, North Coast, Visakhapatnam vide proceedings No.167SE/CE/NC/VSP/DEE/AEE.7/MTR/Designs/Vol.4, dated 16.11.2020.
2.The balance works of Off Shore Reservoir is in progress.
The Earthen Bund, Head Regulators, Spillway, Excavation of right main canal are in progress.
3. The Demarcation of Left Main canal from head reach is started and is in progress.
The excavation of work of Left Main Canal will be shortly commenced and the work at the canal reach requested by the petitioners yet to be started.

4.In the Lr.No.EE/MCD/TKL/DB/AE/ATO/MTR/LA/06, dated 05.01.2021 is an information pertaining to alternative alignment raised by the petitioners was technically not feasible submitted by the Executive Engineer, B.R.R. Vamsadhara Project Main Canal Division, Tekkali to the Special Deputy Collector, Land Acquisition Unit-3, Srikakulam."

sentences.text: Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition also furnished written instructions wherein it is stated that the lands were acquired for an extent of Acs.35.55 cents of Wet, Manavari and Dry lands situated at Karajada village of Meliyaputti Mandal in Srikakulam District and the Award was passed vide Award No.16/2021, dated 11.08.2021 in Progs. Rc.No.2213/2019/G3, dated 04.08.2021 of the Collector, Srikakulam.
After completion of Land Acquisition process in all respects, necessary compensation was not paid to all the Awardees covered by the Award due to insufficient funds.

7. In view of the written instructions submitted by learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition, it is clear and categorical that pursuant to the original alignment for forming Off- Shore Reservoir left channel, the lands were already acquired and award was passed in respect of the affected farmers.

Therefore, the request of the petitioner for change of alignment cannot be considered at this juncture which may lead to further loss of exchequer to the Government for further acquisition of newly effected lands.

8. Having regard to the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for the respondents, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition and on perusal of the material on record and written instructions submitted by learned Government Pleaders, it is observed that pursuant to the original approval alignment for forming off shore left canal channel, the effected lands were already acquired and Award was passed in respect of affected farmers.
Therefore changing of alignment as requested by the petitioner is contrary to the approved alignment by the competent authority and technical experts.
It is further observed that any change of original alignment may cause further financial burden upon the respondents and also the subject project would be much delayed.

Moreover, any change of alignment as requested by the petitioner which is running in deep cutting about 24-30 feet depth in between two hills and running idle without commanding any ayacut due to deep cut portion and there is an existing hill for a length of about 3 Km on the right side of the alternative alignment of Left Main Canal.
The land acquisition cost for alternative alignment will be increased due to running in deep cut portion and providing berms for alternate canal.

Therefore, the claim of the petitioner was genuinely rejected and the petitioner does not have any legal right to enforce their right of change of alignment which was already approved, to that effect an Award was passed and compensation was also paid.

Therefore,
the claim of the petitioner is devoid of any merits and liable to be dismissed.
9. Accordingly, Writ Petition is dismissed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Consequently, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
